question: One patient is diagnosed with a 4 cm lung cancer without pleural contact in the right upper lobe. The extension study reveals the presence of metastasis in right parahilar nodes, without evidence of distant metastasis. The staging of the tumor will be:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "4 cm lung cancer" -> "right upper lobe" -> "no pleural contact" -> "right parahilar node metastasis" -> "no distant metastasis" -> "Stage IIIA" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Tumor size 4 cm" -> "right upper lobe location" -> "metastasis to right parahilar nodes" -> "no distant metastasis" -> "Stage IIIA" -> 90%
CHAIN: "Lung cancer" -> "4 cm size" -> "right parahilar node involvement" -> "no pleural contact" -> "no distant metastasis" -> "Stage IIIA" -> 88%
analysis: The tumor is 4 cm in size, which corresponds to T2a (tumor >3 cm but ≤5 cm). The presence of metastasis in right parahilar nodes indicates N1 (metastasis to ipsilateral peribronchial and/or ipsilateral hilar lymph nodes). There is no evidence of distant metastasis, so M0. According to the TNM staging system for lung cancer, a T2a N1 M0 tumor is classified as Stage IIB.
